exposure: placental regions (central basal, central chorionic, peripheral basal, peripheral chorionic)
cohort: The study included 52 normotensive control women and 43 women with preeclampsia (18 delivered at term and 25 delivered preterm).
finding: Elevated MMP-2 protein levels were observed in all regions of preterm preeclampsia placentae, while lower MMP-9 mRNA expression in both preterm and term preeclampsia may contribute to disturbed placental vascularization.
cross-section timing: Placental samples were collected at the time of delivery.
gest_age: Term and preterm deliveries were differentiated for preeclampsia groups.
